item.title: Better JIT for Postgres
item.description:
📝 A lightweight JIT compilation provider for PostgreSQL that adds three alternative JIT backends - sljit, AsmJit and MIR - delivering faster compilation and competitive query execution across PostgreSQL 14–18. pg_jitter provides native code generation with microsecond-level compilation times instead of milliseconds, making JIT worthwhile for a much wider range of queries. Build # Build all backends.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/vladich/pg_jitter

item.title: Giving LLMs a personality is just good engineering
item.description:
📝 AI systems are human-like because that is the best way to build a capable AI system. What this means in practice is that you have to give the model a personality during post-training1. You simply cannot build a capable AI system that “just acts like a tool”, because the model is trained on humans writing to and about other humans.
🔗 Read more: https://www.seangoedecke.com/giving-llms-a-personality/
